meaning:
ἐνταφιάζω
[in LXX: Gen.50:2 (חָנַט; cf. ἐνταφιαστής, Gen.50:2 for רָפָא; see Deiss., BS, 120 f.; MM, Exp., xiii)* ;]
a κοινή word (Deiss., LAE, 723),
to prepare for burial: Mat.26:12, Jhn.19:40.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.
So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.
